Don't print it (use keynote-white for PDF handouts). 117 118 ### boardroom 119 - **Overview.** PowerPoint-corporate done well: navy, serif titles, gold accent, rules above the footer. 120 - **Colors.** bg `#fff`, surface `#eef1f6`, ink `#0b2545`, ink2 `#46576f`, rule `#c8d0dc`, brand `#c19a3d` (text version `#7a5a0a`); hero bg navy `#0b2545` with gold `#e2b658`. 121 - **Typography.** Source Serif 4 (600) titles, Source Sans 3 body, JetBrains Mono. 122 - **Shape.** 2 px radius, square bars, 1 px rules. 123 - **Signature.** Gold spine on title and closing slides; gold left bar on every title; navy code panel. 124 - **Do / Don't.** Do put the decision on the last slide. Don't use more than one chart per slide. 125 126 ### swiss 127 - **Overview.** International typographic style: hard grid, black rules, one red. 128 - **Colors.** bg `#fff`, surface `#f0f0f0`, ink `#111`, ink2 `#555`, rule `#cfcfcf`, strong rule `#111`, brand `#d7000f`; hero slides are solid red with white type. 129 - **Typography.** Inter Tight 700 (-0.03em) display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono. 130 - **Shape.** Zero radius everywhere, 2 px black rule above the footer. 131 - **Signature.** A 96x20 red tab on the top margin and full-red hero slides. 132 - **Do / Don't.** Do align everything to the grid. Don't round corners. 133 134 ### editorial 135 - **Overview.** A printed essay: paper, ink, oxblood, italic emphasis. 136 - **Colors.** bg `#f4efe6`, surface `#ebe4d6`, ink `#1c1a17`, ink2 `#5a5347`, rule `#cfc5b2`, brand `#8f2d17`; hero is ink `#1c1a17` with terracotta `#e49467`. 137 - **Typography.** Newsreader 400 display (italic for `<em>`), Inter body, JetBrains Mono. 138 - **Shape.** Zero radius, 1 px rules. 139 - **Signature.** A masthead double rule across the top of every slide. 140 - **Do / Don't.** Do write full sentences as titles. Don't use all-caps. 141 142 ### studio 143 - **Overview.** Deep teal and amber, the look of the Wireless 101 courses: for teaching and talks. 144 - **Colors.** bg `#0a2a2f`, surface `#0f3a40`, ink `#efe8d8`, ink2 `#a9c0bd`, rule `#2c5a5f`, brand `#f0a93b` (on-brand `#0a2a2f`); hero `#061c20`. 145 - **Typography.** Instrument Serif display (italic amber `<em>`), DM Sans body, Space Mono labels. 146 - **Shape.** 4 px radius, 2 px bars. 147 - **Signature.** An amber dot starts every label. 148 - **Do / Don't.** Do keep diagrams to the amber and cream. Don't add a second accent. 149 150 Press **S** in any deck to switch theme and font pairing live; hovering an option previews it on the slide, a click keeps it (remembered per deck in localStorage). 151 152 **Font library** (9 core pairings below live in the template; the profession pairings live in `library/fonts/` and are copied into a deck with `tools/add-look.mjs`. The settings panel groups them as Core and Library, and picking a library theme selects its own pairing; `fonts.html` shows them all as specimens with your own headline): Inter (neo-grotesk), Sora/Inter (geometric), Space Grotesk/Inter (grotesk with character), IBM Plex Sans/Plex Mono (technical), Fraunces/Inter, Playfair/Source Sans, 153 Spectral/Public Sans, Cormorant Garamond/Source Sans (set at 1.15x via `--display-scale`), and system fonts. Type sizes come from one scale: `--t-display --t-h1 --t-h2 --t-h3 --t-body --t-small` (164/132/84/48/36/28 px; 28 px is the floor for anything the audience reads). 154 Set one with `data-fonts="sora"` on `<html>`. To recolour any theme, add one line: `html{--brand:#7c3aed;--brand-text:#7c3aed}`. 155 156 ## 5. Builds, transitions, Magic Move 157 158 **Builds** reveal parts of a slide one click at a time. Right arrow / space / click reveals the next build, then the next slide; left steps back. 159 160 | Attribute | Effect | 161 |---|---| 162 | `data-build="fade"`, `rise`, `scale`, `wipe` | the element appears | 163 | `data-build="list"` on a `ul`/`ol` | children appear one by one (`data-item="fade"` to change the style) | 164 | `data-build="draw"` on an SVG shape or `<g>` | strokes draw themselves (every shape inside is staggered) | 165 | `data-build="count"` | the number counts up from 0 (`$4.2M`, `38.4%`, `1,840` all work); markup holds the final value | 166 | `data-build="draw"` on a chart figure | bars grow, lines draw, labels arrive | 167 | `data-focus="1-3;5-7;*"` on a `pre` | each click lights the next range of lines (`*` = all) | 168 | `data-order="2"` | builds with the same order arrive together; give all builds an order or none | 169 | `data-delay="200"` | extra delay in ms | 170 171 Print, overview thumbnails and `check.mjs` always show every build; the presenter window's Next pane shows the next one. Charts take `data-target="200"` (a dashed target line), `data-delta="pct"` or `"abs"` (a delta label on two-series columns), `data-muted="2"` (which series is the muted reference; with two bar series the second is one by default, `data-equal` turns that off) and `data-highlight` (also on line charts). Chart data is exposed to screen readers as a hidden table. Use builds where order matters; most slides need none. 172 173 **Skip, appendix and the end.** `data-skip` on a slide keeps it in the overview, outline and PDF but jumps over it in play (Keynote's Skip Slide); use it for backup slides. A slide with `data-layout="appendix"` renders as a section divider and it and every slide after it are skipped in play. Pressing next on the last slide shows an "End of show" screen (`data-end="off"` on the deck turns it off). Cite sources with `<sup class="cite">[1]</sup>` and list them on a `references` slide (`<ol class="refs"><li><div><cite>Title</cite> <span>Detail</span></div></li></ol>`). Recipes: an agenda that returns at each section break, with `aria-current` on the current item; a Q&A slide is a `closing` slide whose label says Questions. 174 175 **Transitions.** Default is a quick dissolve. `data-transition="push"`, `"move-in"` or `"none"` per slide (the incoming slide's setting wins). 176 177 **Magic Move.** Give an element on one slide and an element on the next the same `data-magic="id"` and they morph: position, size, colour, 178 opacity. If the typeface differs between the two (sentence to chip, serif to mono) it cross-fades while it travels. It works on text, boxes 179 and SVG; use a `<span>` rather than `<em>` for text that changes colour. A slide pair with no shared ids just dissolves. 180 181 ## 6. Diagrams that draw 182 183 Author the SVG with `viewBox="0 0 1680 H"` (so 1 unit is 1 px at full width) and use the engine classes so it follows the theme: 184 `dg-box` (outline), `dg-hot` (accent outline), `dg-line` and `dg-line hot`, `dg-dot`, text classes `dg-t` (label), `dg-s` (small), `dg-m` (mono), `dg-b` (accent). 185 Wrap groups in `<g data-build="fade" data-order="1">` for boxes and `<g data-build="draw" data-order="2">` for arrows (stroke-only paths, arrowheads as part of 186 the path). Crop the viewBox to the content (`viewBox="0 150 1680 330"`) so the diagram fills the slide. See `examples/src/gen_diagrams.py` for generators. 187 188 ## 6b. Images 189 190 Photos and illustrations go in `<img>` inside `image-left`, `image-right`, `team`, or as `data-bg` / `<img class="bleed">` on `full-bleed` (cropped with `object-fit: cover`, scrim added for legibility). 191 Always give `alt` text. Re-encode photos without EXIF/GPS (Pillow: open, convert, save; `sips` alone keeps metadata). 192 193 Local generation (nothing leaves the machine): `tools/gen-images.sh` renders the illustrations in `assets/` with the Draw Things CLI (`z_image_turbo`), strips metadata through Pillow and 194 writes JPEGs of about 70 to 110 KB; `tools/gen-images.sh name "prompt" seed WxH` renders one more. Rules that came from the Wireless 101 pipeline: generated images are **illustrative only**; never ask 195 for text, numbers, charts or diagrams (models garble them, so those stay SVG); no real people or brands; judge each render and drop the bad ones. 196 The four examples use `assets/aria-hero.jpg`, `aria-market.jpg` and `warehouse.jpg`; `abstract-teal.jpg` is a spare for dark decks. 197 198 ## 7. Presenter keys and tools 199 200 | Key | Action | 201 |---|---| 202 | right, down, space, PageDown, N, click | next build / slide | 203 | left, up, PageUp, Backspace, Shift+space | previous | 204 | Home / End | first / last slide | 205 | number + Enter | jump to slide (a toast shows what you typed; works in the presenter window too) | 206 | **G** | overview (light table; arrows move, Enter opens). **Esc** only closes panels, the overview, the laser or the marker; it never opens anything, so a clicker's Esc cannot put the grid on the projector | 207 | **P** | presenter view in a new window (this is the presenter view, not PDF export): current slide, a Next pane that previews the next build (or the next slide when builds are done), notes (A- / A+ or + / - change their size), timer (click or T pauses; `data-duration="20"` on the deck makes it a countdown that turns amber for the last two minutes), clock, an AUDIENCE SCREEN badge when the projector is blanked. Every key above works there too, and it reconnects if the audience window is reloaded (allow pop-ups) | 208 | **M** | marker: draw on the slide with mouse, pen or finger. **1 2 3 4** red / yellow / blue / white, **H** highlighter, **E** eraser, **Ctrl/Cmd+Z** undo, **C** clear, **Esc** leave. Kept per slide, remembered per deck in localStorage, shown in the presenter window, never printed | 209 | **L** | laser pointer: a red dot follows the mouse and leaves no trace | 210 | **O** | outline: every slide with title, link, layout, build count, notes flag; click to jump, filter, Copy as text; `#` copies one slide's link, Links copies them all | 211 | **K** | copy a link to this slide (also the link button in the toolbar) | 212 | **A** | narration on/off, when the deck has `data-narration` clips (see 12a) | 213 | **S** | theme and font panel; hover or focus a theme or pairing to preview it live on the slide, click to keep it | 214 | **B** or **.** / **W** | black / white screen | 215 | **F** or **F5** | fullscreen (F5 so a clicker's start button does not reload the page) | 216 217 The toolbar at the bottom fades when idle (and the cursor hides). Every slide has a link: `deck.html#pricing`, from `data-id="pricing"` on the section, else from its title, else `#slide-7` (`#/7` and `#7` work too); the address bar follows the current slide. Touch: swipe left/right; tap the 218 left 22% to go back (the rest advances); the toolbar stays visible while it has keyboard focus. `prefers-reduced-motion` is honoured in JS: no transitions, builds appear instantly, counters show the final value. 219 220 ## 8. PDF and print 221 222 Open the deck in Chrome, **Cmd/Ctrl+P**, destination "Save as PDF", margins "None", turn on "Background graphics". `@page` is 1920x1080 px, one slide per 223 page, all builds shown, backgrounds kept, toolbar and marker hidden. Headless: `page.pdf({preferCSSPageSize: true, printBackground: true})`. 224 225 ## 9. Right-to-left and Arabic 226 227 Set `dir="rtl" lang="ar"` on `<html>` (the lang drives chart number formatting: Arabic-Indic digits for `ar`, and `data-build="count"` accepts Arabic-Indic digits) or on a single `<section>`. See `examples/arabic-sample.html`. Serif themes carry `--f-ar-d` (Noto Naskh Arabic) for Arabic headings; Arabic headings get line-height 1.25. All layout uses logical properties, so slides mirror (image-left becomes right, timelines run 228 right to left, the wipe direction flips). An Arabic face loads on demand. Keep code in `dir="ltr"` blocks (the code layout already is). 229 230 ## 10. Checker 231 232 ``` 233 node check.mjs deck.html [more.html] [--themes] [--shots out/] [--outline] 234 ``` 235 236 Opens each deck at 1920x1080, shows every slide with all builds revealed and prints a short list: `slide n: element, what is wrong, fix:`. It reports 237 content outside the safe area (120 px sides, 96 px top/bottom) or the slide, text wider than its box, text under 20 px, text contrast under 4.5:1 (including 238 gradient-filled headline accents), and console errors. Exit code 1 on failure; a 15-slide deck takes about 2 seconds. `--themes` repeats the run in every 239 theme the deck defines (use it before sending a deck to someone who might press S). `--shots` saves a PNG per slide. `--outline` prints the deck's outline (n, title, layout, builds, magic, and `NO NOTES` where notes are missing), handy for reviewing a generated deck without opening it. 240 241 Needs Playwright: `npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium`. Or set `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/path/to/playwright/index.mjs` and 242 `CHROME_PATH=/path/to/chrome`. 243 244 ## 12. Checklist before you present 245 246 - `node check.mjs deck.html --themes` is green. 247 - Press **G**: the sequence reads as a story; every slide has one claim. 248 - Press **P**: notes on every slide that needs one; the timer works. 249 - Try the Magic Move pairs and the builds once in presentation order. 250 - Print to PDF and look at page 1, the chart page and the last page. 251 - Open with the system's reduced-motion setting on if your audience may need it. 252 253 ## 12a. Narration (recorded voice per slide) 254 255 Add `data-narration="audio/my-deck/"` to `<main class="deck">` and put one MP3 per slide in that folder, named after the 256 slide's link id (`data-id`, for example `audio/my-deck/pricing.mp3`). A speaker button appears in the toolbar once the first 257 slide's clip loads (key **A**, also from the presenter window). While narration is on, each slide plays its clip, shows all 258 its builds, and moves to the next slide when the clip ends; navigating by hand keeps narrating from where you land. 259 Until the files exist the deck shows no button at all, so a deck can ship first and get its voice later. 260 261 ## 12b. Slides that run 262 263 A slide is a web page, so it can hold things a slide file can't: a working app screen, a calculator, a simulation you drag, 264 sound and speech, code you edit and run, a game, another page in an iframe, a video that plays only on its slide, a live camera. 265 `examples/beyond-slides.html` has one of each; its source (`examples/src/beyond-slides.html`) is the pattern to copy: 266 wrap widgets in `.bx-ui` (clicks there don't advance), take colours from the theme tokens, and run anything that moves or 267 makes sound only while the slide is current. The video in it (`assets/edit-in-browser.mp4`) is a recording of `editor.html`. 268 269 ## 13. Known limits 270 271 - Web fonts come from Google Fonts on demand; offline, the system fallbacks in each stack are used (set `data-fonts="system"` for fully offline decks). 272 - Charts are simple on purpose: column, bar and line, up to three series, no stacked or dual-axis. 273 - Magic Move morphs matching elements; it does not morph SVG path shapes into different paths. 274 - The presenter view needs pop-ups allowed and uses `postMessage`, so both windows must stay open. 275 - The engine fits type by shrinking to 78% (display numbers and headlines to 50%); below that the checker reports the slide instead of shrinking further. 276 277 <!-- LIBRARY:START (generated by tools/build-gallery.mjs from tools/library-data.mjs; edit the data file) --> 278

file.content: # Keynote Pro manual (the engine behind present-in-html) Paths below are the engine's. In this skill: `check.mjs` and `tools/*.mjs` are in `scripts/`; `template.html`, `library/` and `examples/` are in `assets/`. Build tools and the sample decks mentioned here are not shipped with the skill. - 1. Write a deck in 60 seconds - 2. Layout cheat-sheet (shortest working snippet for each) - 3. Deck recipes (theme, fonts, sequence, builds) - 4. Theme design plans (DESIGN.md format) - 5. Builds, transitions, Magic Move - 6. Diagrams that draw - 6b. Images - 7. Presenter keys and tools - 8. PDF and print - 9. Right-to-left and Arabic - 10. Checker - 12. Checklist before you present - 12a. Narration (recorded voice per slide) - 12b. Slides that run - 13. Known limits ## 1. Write a deck in 60 seconds 1. Copy `template.html`. Set `data-theme` (and optionally `data-fonts`) on ``, and the title in `` and `data-title` on `<main class="deck">`. 2. Delete the sample slides. Add `<section class="slide" data-layout="...">` blocks (cheat-sheet below). 3. Add `<aside class="notes"><p>...</p></aside>` inside any slide for presenter notes. 4. `node check.mjs my-deck.html`, fix what it lists, open it, press **P**. Rules of thumb: one idea per slide; at most 5 bullets; say the number, not the paragraph. Layouts auto-fit (type shrinks to 78% before content would leave the safe area, and short content grows, up to 1.25x on bullets and 1.5x on statements, so a slide is never half empty), lists balance their wrapping, images crop with `object-fit: cover`. You never tune CSS to make text fit; if `check.mjs` still complains, cut words. ## 2. Layout cheat-sheet (shortest working snippet for each) Every snippet goes inside `<section class="slide" data-layout="NAME"> ... </section>`. Optional extras are in comments. ```html <!-- title --> <h1>Title with <em>one accent</em></h1><p class="sub">Subtitle</p> <!-- <p class="label">Event</p> <p class="meta"><span>Name</span><span>Date</span></p> --> <!-- section --> <h2>Part two</h2> <!-- <p class="label">Part two</p> <span class="num">2</span> <p>One-line promise</p> --> <!-- statement --> <h2>One huge sentence with an <em>accent</em>.</h2> <!-- agenda --> <h2>Agenda</h2><ol><li>Results <small>10 min</small></li><li>Plan</li></ol> <!-- aria-current on an li dims the rest --> <!-- bullets --> <h2>Title</h2><ul data-build="list"><li><strong>Lead.</strong> Support.</li><li>Two</li><li>Three</li></ul> <!-- two-column --> <h2>Title</h2><div class="col"><h3>A</h3><p>Text</p></div><div class="col"><h3>B</h3><ul><li>x</li></ul></div> <!-- image-left --> <figure><img src="a.jpg" alt=""></figure><h2>Title</h2><p>Text</p> <!-- empty <figure></figure> = placeholder art --> <!-- image-right --> (same markup, mirrored) <!-- full-bleed --> <h2>Title on a photo</h2> <!-- data-bg="photo.jpg" on the section, or <img class="bleed" src alt=""> --> <!-- big-number --> <div class="big" data-build="count">98<small>%</small></div><p>One honest caption.</p> <!-- <p class="src">Source</p> --> <!-- stats --> <h2>Title</h2><div class="stat"><b>4.2M</b><span>Users</span></div> ...2 to 4 of these <!-- chart --> <h2>Title</h2><p class="lede">Takeaway</p> <figure class="chart" data-chart="column" data-values="Q1:12,Q2:18,Q3:21"></figure> <!-- data-chart: column | bar | line. Multi-series: put a <table> inside (header row + label column). data-prefix="$" data-unit="M" data-decimals="1" data-highlight="3" (1-based or a label) data-min="92" (line charts only) data-build="draw" (bars grow, lines draw) data-wide on the section = full-width plot; <figcaption>Source</figcaption> --> <!-- comparison --> <h2>Title</h2><table><thead><tr><th></th><th>A</th><th class="rec" data-tag="Recommended">B</th></tr></thead> <tbody><tr><th>Price</th><td>$1</td><td>$2</td></tr></tbody></table> <!-- timeline --> <h2>Title</h2><ol class="timeline" data-build="list"><li><time>Q1</time><h3>Step</h3><p>Detail</p></li>...</ol> <!-- class="now" marks today --> <!-- process --> <h2>Title</h2><ol class="steps" data-build="list"><li><h3>Capture</h3><p>Detail</p></li>...</ol> <!-- 3 to 5 steps --> <!-- quote --> <blockquote>The quote with an <em>accent</em>.</blockquote><cite><b>Name</b>Title, Company</cite> <!-- code --> <h2>Title</h2><pre data-lang="js" data-focus="1-2;4-6;*"> code </pre> <!-- indent freely; focus steps light lines per click --> <!-- team --> <h2>Team</h2><div class="people"><figure class="person" data-initials="AK"><figcaption><b>Ann</b><span>Role</span></figcaption></figure>...</div> <!-- diagram --> <h2>Title</h2><figure class="dg"><svg viewBox="0 0 1680 400">...</svg></figure> <!-- see Diagrams --> <!-- case --> <p class="label">Case</p><h2>Title</h2><div class="pt"><h3>History</h3><p>Summary</p></div> <div class="vitals"><div class="vital" data-flag="high"><span>BP</span><b>162/94</b></div><div class="vital"><span>HR</span><b>96</b></div></div> <ol class="course" data-build="list"><li><time>00:06</time>Event</li></ol> <!-- summary left; 2 to 4 vitals; timed course. data-flag marks an abnormal value --> <!-- ask --> <h2>Raising a seed round</h2><div class="amount"><b data-build="count">$2.5<small>M</small></b><span>What it buys</span></div> <ul class="use"><li style="--w:50"><b>Engineering</b><span>50%</span><i></i></li></ul><dl class="terms"><div><dt>Instrument</dt><dd>SAFE</dd></div></dl> <!-- rows --> <h2>Title</h2><ol class="rows"><li data-k="Issue"><p>Text</p></li><li data-k="Conclusion" data-hot><h3>Bold line</h3><p>Text</p></li></ol> <!-- labelled rows: issue / rule / application / conclusion; situation / complication / resolution; claim / evidence / caveat. data-hot highlights one --> <!-- quiz --> <h2>Question?</h2><ol class="opts" data-build="reveal"><li>A</li><li data-correct>B</li><li>C</li><li>D</li></ol> <!-- the click marks the data-correct option --> <!-- materials --> <h2>Title</h2><div class="board"><figure class="mat" style="--sw:#9a9892"><figcaption><b>Concrete</b><span>Where it goes</span></figcaption></figure>...</div> <!-- or an <img> in each figure; --tx adds a texture gradient --> <!-- formula --> <h2>Title</h2><div class="eq"><i>P<sub>r</sub></i> = <i>P<sub>t</sub></i> − <span class="hot"><i>L</i></span></div><dl class="terms"><div><dt><i>P<sub>t</sub></i></dt><dd>Meaning</dd></div></dl> <!-- two-column x3 -> add data-cols="3" to the section for three columns (now / next / later) --> <!-- closing --> <h2>Thank you</h2><p class="contact"><span><b>Web</b> example.com</span><span>me@example.com</span></p> ``` Extras: `<p class="label">` is the small mono kicker above a title (use it on some slides, not all). `.chip` is a boxed token; `.chip.hot` highlights one. `.lede`, `.src` and `<small>` are secondary text. `data-footer="off"` hides the footer, `data-fit="off"` stops auto-fit, `data-tone="hero"` (or `"plain"`) swaps a slide into (or out of) the theme's hero palette. ## 3. Deck recipes (theme, fonts, sequence, builds) Fonts: `data-fonts` is optional; leave it empty to use the theme's own pairing. | Need | Theme | Sequence of layouts | Builds | |---|---|---|---| | **Product launch** | `keynote-black` (cinematic) or `keynote-white` | title, statement, statement + big-number (Magic Move on the number), stats, full-bleed, image-left, chart or comparison, quote, timeline, closing | `count` on stats, `list` on timeline, magic on the hero number | | **Quarterly / board review** | `boardroom` | title, agenda, big-number, chart (actual vs plan), stats, chart (line with `data-min`), section, comparison (mark `rec`), two-column (risks / mitigations), timeline, bullets (decisions), closing | `count` on KPIs, `draw` on charts, `list` on decisions | | **Tech talk** | `swiss` (or `studio`) | title, statement + big-number (problem), diagram (before), section, diagram (after), process, code (`data-focus`), chart (line), comparison, two-column (worked / didn't), stats, closing | `draw` + `fade` on diagram groups, focus on code | | **Training / course** | `studio` (or `editorial`) | title, agenda, statement, diagrams, process, big-number, chart, comparison, code, quote, timeline (where we are), closing | `list`, `draw`, one `count` | | **Investor pitch** | `keynote-white` + `data-fonts="grotesk"` | title, statement (problem), big-number (market), image-left (solution), stats (traction), chart (growth), comparison (vs alternatives), team, timeline (use of funds), closing | `count` on traction, `draw` on the growth chart | | **Weekly status update** | `editorial` or `keynote-white` | title, bullets (done), stats (health), chart (trend), timeline (next), two-column (risks / asks), closing | `list` only; keep it quiet | Authoring order that works in one pass: write the title and the one-sentence story, pick the recipe, write each slide's single claim as its `<h2>`, then add the supporting snippet, then notes, then run `check.mjs`. ## 4. Theme design plans (DESIGN.md format) Each theme is a real, shippable look. One accent, hairline rules, big type. All body text is at least 4.5:1. ### keynote-white - **Overview.** Apple-clean. Mostly white, enormous tightly-tracked headlines, one blue phrase per slide. Fits launches, pitches, status decks. - **Colors.** bg `#ffffff`, surface `#f5f5f7`, ink `#1d1d1f`, ink2 `#5f5f64`, rule `#d2d2d7`, brand `#0066cc` (on-brand `#fff`), hero = same as page. - **Typography.** Display and body Inter (700 display, -0.035em), mono JetBrains Mono for labels and code. - **Shape.** Radius 14 px (panels), 6 px bars, 1 px rules. - **Signature.** Whitespace and scale; the accent `<em>` is the only colour on a title. - **Do / Don't.** Do keep slides sparse. Don't add boxes around everything. ### keynote-black - **Overview.** Cinematic dark for reveals and demos; the same system on pure black. - **Colors.** bg `#000`, surface `#161618`, ink `#f5f5f7`, ink2 `#a1a1a6`, rule `#38383a`, brand `#2997ff`, em gradient `#2997ff` to `#c58bff`. - **Typography.** Inter 700 display; JetBrains Mono. - **Shape.** 14 px radius, 6 px bars. - **Signature.** Gradient-filled headline accent, the only gradient in the system. Code panel `#1c1c1e` with Xcode-dark colours. - **Do / Don't.** Do use for rooms with dim light. Don't print it (use keynote-white for PDF handouts). ### boardroom - **Overview.** PowerPoint-corporate done well: navy, serif titles, gold accent, rules above the footer. - **Colors.** bg `#fff`, surface `#eef1f6`, ink `#0b2545`, ink2 `#46576f`, rule `#c8d0dc`, brand `#c19a3d` (text version `#7a5a0a`); hero bg navy `#0b2545` with gold `#e2b658`. - **Typography.** Source Serif 4 (600) titles, Source Sans 3 body, JetBrains Mono. - **Shape.** 2 px radius, square bars, 1 px rules. - **Signature.** Gold spine on title and closing slides; gold left bar on every title; navy code panel. - **Do / Don't.** Do put the decision on the last slide. Don't use more than one chart per slide. ### swiss - **Overview.** International typographic style: hard grid, black rules, one red. - **Colors.** bg `#fff`, surface `#f0f0f0`, ink `#111`, ink2 `#555`, rule `#cfcfcf`, strong rule `#111`, brand `#d7000f`; hero slides are solid red with white type. - **Typography.** Inter Tight 700 (-0.03em) display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono. - **Shape.** Zero radius everywhere, 2 px black rule above the footer. - **Signature.** A 96x20 red tab on the top margin and full-red hero slides. - **Do / Don't.** Do align everything to the grid. Don't round corners. ### editorial - **Overview.** A printed essay: paper, ink, oxblood, italic emphasis. - **Colors.** bg `#f4efe6`, surface `#ebe4d6`, ink `#1c1a17`, ink2 `#5a5347`, rule `#cfc5b2`, brand `#8f2d17`; hero is ink `#1c1a17` with terracotta `#e49467`. - **Typography.** Newsreader 400 display (italic for `<em>`), Inter body, JetBrains Mono. - **Shape.** Zero radius, 1 px rules. - **Signature.** A masthead double rule across the top of every slide. - **Do / Don't.** Do write full sentences as titles. Don't use all-caps. ### studio - **Overview.** Deep teal and amber, the look of the Wireless 101 courses: for teaching and talks. - **Colors.** bg `#0a2a2f`, surface `#0f3a40`, ink `#efe8d8`, ink2 `#a9c0bd`, rule `#2c5a5f`, brand `#f0a93b` (on-brand `#0a2a2f`); hero `#061c20`. - **Typography.** Instrument Serif display (italic amber `<em>`), DM Sans body, Space Mono labels. - **Shape.** 4 px radius, 2 px bars. - **Signature.** An amber dot starts every label. - **Do / Don't.** Do keep diagrams to the amber and cream. Don't add a second accent. Press **S** in any deck to switch theme and font pairing live; hovering an option previews it on the slide, a click keeps it (remembered per deck in localStorage). **Font library** (9 core pairings below live in the template; the profession pairings live in `library/fonts/` and are copied into a deck with `tools/add-look.mjs`. The settings panel groups them as Core and Library, and picking a library theme selects its own pairing; `fonts.html` shows them all as specimens with your own headline): Inter (neo-grotesk), Sora/Inter (geometric), Space Grotesk/Inter (grotesk with character), IBM Plex Sans/Plex Mono (technical), Fraunces/Inter, Playfair/Source Sans, Spectral/Public Sans, Cormorant Garamond/Source Sans (set at 1.15x via `--display-scale`), and system fonts. Type sizes come from one scale: `--t-display --t-h1 --t-h2 --t-h3 --t-body --t-small` (164/132/84/48/36/28 px; 28 px is the floor for anything the audience reads). Set one with `data-fonts="sora"` on `<html>`. To recolour any theme, add one line: `html{--brand:#7c3aed;--brand-text:#7c3aed}`. ## 5. Builds, transitions, Magic Move **Builds** reveal parts of a slide one click at a time. Right arrow / space / click reveals the next build, then the next slide; left steps back. | Attribute | Effect | |---|---| | `data-build="fade"`, `rise`, `scale`, `wipe` | the element appears | | `data-build="list"` on a `ul`/`ol` | children appear one by one (`data-item="fade"` to change the style) | | `data-build="draw"` on an SVG shape or `<g>` | strokes draw themselves (every shape inside is staggered) | | `data-build="count"` | the number counts up from 0 (`$4.2M`, `38.4%`, `1,840` all work); markup holds the final value | | `data-build="draw"` on a chart figure | bars grow, lines draw, labels arrive | | `data-focus="1-3;5-7;*"` on a `pre` | each click lights the next range of lines (`*` = all) | | `data-order="2"` | builds with the same order arrive together; give all builds an order or none | | `data-delay="200"` | extra delay in ms | Print, overview thumbnails and `check.mjs` always show every build; the presenter window's Next pane shows the next one. Charts take `data-target="200"` (a dashed target line), `data-delta="pct"` or `"abs"` (a delta label on two-series columns), `data-muted="2"` (which series is the muted reference; with two bar series the second is one by default, `data-equal` turns that off) and `data-highlight` (also on line charts). Chart data is exposed to screen readers as a hidden table. Use builds where order matters; most slides need none. **Skip, appendix and the end.** `data-skip` on a slide keeps it in the overview, outline and PDF but jumps over it in play (Keynote's Skip Slide); use it for backup slides. A slide with `data-layout="appendix"` renders as a section divider and it and every slide after it are skipped in play. Pressing next on the last slide shows an "End of show" screen (`data-end="off"` on the deck turns it off). Cite sources with `<sup class="cite">[1]</sup>` and list them on a `references` slide (`<ol class="refs"><li><div><cite>Title</cite> <span>Detail</span></div></li></ol>`). Recipes: an agenda that returns at each section break, with `aria-current` on the current item; a Q&A slide is a `closing` slide whose label says Questions. **Transitions.** Default is a quick dissolve. `data-transition="push"`, `"move-in"` or `"none"` per slide (the incoming slide's setting wins). **Magic Move.** Give an element on one slide and an element on the next the same `data-magic="id"` and they morph: position, size, colour, opacity. If the typeface differs between the two (sentence to chip, serif to mono) it cross-fades while it travels. It works on text, boxes and SVG; use a `<span>` rather than `<em>` for text that changes colour. A slide pair with no shared ids just dissolves. ## 6. Diagrams that draw Author the SVG with `viewBox="0 0 1680 H"` (so 1 unit is 1 px at full width) and use the engine classes so it follows the theme: `dg-box` (outline), `dg-hot` (accent outline), `dg-line` and `dg-line hot`, `dg-dot`, text classes `dg-t` (label), `dg-s` (small), `dg-m` (mono), `dg-b` (accent). Wrap groups in `<g data-build="fade" data-order="1">` for boxes and `<g data-build="draw" data-order="2">` for arrows (stroke-only paths, arrowheads as part of the path). Crop the viewBox to the content (`viewBox="0 150 1680 330"`) so the diagram fills the slide. See `examples/src/gen_diagrams.py` for generators. ## 6b. Images Photos and illustrations go in `<img>` inside `image-left`, `image-right`, `team`, or as `data-bg` / `<img class="bleed">` on `full-bleed` (cropped with `object-fit: cover`, scrim added for legibility). Always give `alt` text. Re-encode photos without EXIF/GPS (Pillow: open, convert, save; `sips` alone keeps metadata). Local generation (nothing leaves the machine): `tools/gen-images.sh` renders the illustrations in `assets/` with the Draw Things CLI (`z_image_turbo`), strips metadata through Pillow and writes JPEGs of about 70 to 110 KB; `tools/gen-images.sh name "prompt" seed WxH` renders one more. Rules that came from the Wireless 101 pipeline: generated images are **illustrative only**; never ask for text, numbers, charts or diagrams (models garble them, so those stay SVG); no real people or brands; judge each render and drop the bad ones. The four examples use `assets/aria-hero.jpg`, `aria-market.jpg` and `warehouse.jpg`; `abstract-teal.jpg` is a spare for dark decks. ## 7. Presenter keys and tools | Key | Action | |---|---| | right, down, space, PageDown, N, click | next build / slide | | left, up, PageUp, Backspace, Shift+space | previous | | Home / End | first / last slide | | number + Enter | jump to slide (a toast shows what you typed; works in the presenter window too) | | **G** | overview (light table; arrows move, Enter opens). **Esc** only closes panels, the overview, the laser or the marker; it never opens anything, so a clicker's Esc cannot put the grid on the projector | | **P** | presenter view in a new window (this is the presenter view, not PDF export): current slide, a Next pane that previews the next build (or the next slide when builds are done), notes (A- / A+ or + / - change their size), timer (click or T pauses; `data-duration="20"` on the deck makes it a countdown that turns amber for the last two minutes), clock, an AUDIENCE SCREEN badge when the projector is blanked. Every key above works there too, and it reconnects if the audience window is reloaded (allow pop-ups) | | **M** | marker: draw on the slide with mouse, pen or finger. **1 2 3 4** red / yellow / blue / white, **H** highlighter, **E** eraser, **Ctrl/Cmd+Z** undo, **C** clear, **Esc** leave. Kept per slide, remembered per deck in localStorage, shown in the presenter window, never printed | | **L** | laser pointer: a red dot follows the mouse and leaves no trace | | **O** | outline: every slide with title, link, layout, build count, notes flag; click to jump, filter, Copy as text; `#` copies one slide's link, Links copies them all | | **K** | copy a link to this slide (also the link button in the toolbar) | | **A** | narration on/off, when the deck has `data-narration` clips (see 12a) | | **S** | theme and font panel; hover or focus a theme or pairing to preview it live on the slide, click to keep it | | **B** or **.** / **W** | black / white screen | | **F** or **F5** | fullscreen (F5 so a clicker's start button does not reload the page) | The toolbar at the bottom fades when idle (and the cursor hides). Every slide has a link: `deck.html#pricing`, from `data-id="pricing"` on the section, else from its title, else `#slide-7` (`#/7` and `#7` work too); the address bar follows the current slide. Touch: swipe left/right; tap the left 22% to go back (the rest advances); the toolbar stays visible while it has keyboard focus. `prefers-reduced-motion` is honoured in JS: no transitions, builds appear instantly, counters show the final value. ## 8. PDF and print Open the deck in Chrome, **Cmd/Ctrl+P**, destination "Save as PDF", margins "None", turn on "Background graphics". `@page` is 1920x1080 px, one slide per page, all builds shown, backgrounds kept, toolbar and marker hidden. Headless: `page.pdf({preferCSSPageSize: true, printBackground: true})`. ## 9. Right-to-left and Arabic Set `dir="rtl" lang="ar"` on `<html>` (the lang drives chart number formatting: Arabic-Indic digits for `ar`, and `data-build="count"` accepts Arabic-Indic digits) or on a single `<section>`. See `examples/arabic-sample.html`. Serif themes carry `--f-ar-d` (Noto Naskh Arabic) for Arabic headings; Arabic headings get line-height 1.25. All layout uses logical properties, so slides mirror (image-left becomes right, timelines run right to left, the wipe direction flips). An Arabic face loads on demand. Keep code in `dir="ltr"` blocks (the code layout already is). ## 10. Checker ``` node check.mjs deck.html [more.html] [--themes] [--shots out/] [--outline] ``` Opens each deck at 1920x1080, shows every slide with all builds revealed and prints a short list: `slide n: element, what is wrong, fix:`. It reports content outside the safe area (120 px sides, 96 px top/bottom) or the slide, text wider than its box, text under 20 px, text contrast under 4.5:1 (including gradient-filled headline accents), and console errors. Exit code 1 on failure; a 15-slide deck takes about 2 seconds. `--themes` repeats the run in every theme the deck defines (use it before sending a deck to someone who might press S). `--shots` saves a PNG per slide. `--outline` prints the deck's outline (n, title, layout, builds, magic, and `NO NOTES` where notes are missing), handy for reviewing a generated deck without opening it. Needs Playwright: `npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium`. Or set `PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/path/to/playwright/index.mjs` and `CHROME_PATH=/path/to/chrome`. ## 12. Checklist before you present - `node check.mjs deck.html --themes` is green. - Press **G**: the sequence reads as a story; every slide has one claim. - Press **P**: notes on every slide that needs one; the timer works. - Try the Magic Move pairs and the builds once in presentation order. - Print to PDF and look at page 1, the chart page and the last page. - Open with the system's reduced-motion setting on if your audience may need it. ## 12a. Narration (recorded voice per slide) Add `data-narration="audio/my-deck/"` to `<main class="deck">` and put one MP3 per slide in that folder, named after the slide's link id (`data-id`, for example `audio/my-deck/pricing.mp3`). A speaker button appears in the toolbar once the first slide's clip loads (key **A**, also from the presenter window). While narration is on, each slide plays its clip, shows all its builds, and moves to the next slide when the clip ends; navigating by hand keeps narrating from where you land. Until the files exist the deck shows no button at all, so a deck can ship first and get its voice later. ## 12b. Slides that run A slide is a web page, so it can hold things a slide file can't: a working app screen, a calculator, a simulation you drag, sound and speech, code you edit and run, a game, another page in an iframe, a video that plays only on its slide, a live camera. `examples/beyond-slides.html` has one of each; its source (`examples/src/beyond-slides.html`) is the pattern to copy: wrap widgets in `.bx-ui` (clicks there don't advance), take colours from the theme tokens, and run anything that moves or makes sound only while the slide is current. The video in it (`assets/edit-in-browser.mp4`) is a recording of `editor.html`. ## 13. Known limits - Web fonts come from Google Fonts on demand; offline, the system fallbacks in each stack are used (set `data-fonts="system"` for fully offline decks). - Charts are simple on purpose: column, bar and line, up to three series, no stacked or dual-axis. - Magic Move morphs matching elements; it does not morph SVG path shapes into different paths. - The presenter view needs pop-ups allowed and uses `postMessage`, so both windows must stay open. - The engine fits type by shrinking to 78% (display numbers and headlines to 50%); below that the checker reports the slide instead of shrinking further. <!-- LIBRARY:START (generated by tools/build-gallery.mjs from tools/library-data.mjs; edit the data file) -->

<!doctype html>
<!--
  KEYNOTE PRO  -  one-file HTML presentation template.
  1. Copy this file.  2. Set data-theme / data-fonts on <html> and the title below.
  3. Replace the slides between SLIDES:START and SLIDES:END.  4. Open in a browser. That is all.
  Keys: arrows/space next-back, O outline, G overview (Esc only closes), P presenter view, M marker (H highlighter, Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo), L laser, S theme+fonts (hover previews), F fullscreen, B/W black/white, 12 Enter jump.
  Docs: README.md.  Engine: the <style id="kp-engine"> and <script> blocks (no dependencies; fonts load from Google on demand).
-->
<html lang="en" data-theme="keynote-white" data-fonts="">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>present-in-html template</title>
<style id="kp-themes">
/* =====================================================================
   THEME TOKEN CONTRACT
   A theme is ONE block: a marker comment "THEME:name | Label | swatch | fonts-url" (written as a CSS comment),
   then html[data-theme="name"]{ ... }, then a closing comment "/THEME". See the real blocks below.
   Layouts and components read ONLY these tokens (no colour, font or weight is hard-coded in layout CSS).
   Themes may add small signature rules (decorations) inside their own block, scoped by [data-theme="name"].
   The settings panel (S) lists whatever THEME / FONTS blocks exist in this <style>. Scripts can add or remove blocks.

   COLOUR (required)
     --bg --bg2          slide background, quiet panel/surface
     --ink --ink2        body text, secondary text   (>= 4.5:1 on --bg and --bg2)
     --rule              hairline colour             --rule-strong   hard rule / table head / outline colour
     --brand             the one accent (fills, bars, dots)      --brand-text  accent used as TEXT (>= 4.5:1 on --bg)
     --on-brand          text drawn on a --brand fill
   HERO SLIDES (title, section, closing, full-bleed, data-tone="hero"; required)
     --hero-bg --hero-ink --hero-ink2 --hero-rule --hero-brand
   FULL-BLEED PLACEHOLDER (required)     --bleed-bg  --bleed-ink    (no-image full-bleed slides; ink >= 4.5:1 on bg)
   TYPE (required)
     --f-display --f-body --f-mono       font stacks (end with a generic family)
     --w-display --ls-display            display weight, display letter-spacing
     --em-style                          <em> in headings: italic | normal (it takes the slide's --brand-text)
     --em-fill (optional)                a fixed gradient for headline <em> (e.g. keynote-black); omit to use --brand-text
   SHAPE (required)
     --radius        panels, process boxes, chips, code panel      --chart-radius  bar corner radius (px number)
     --rule-w        weight of structural rules (1px | 2px)
   CHART + DIAGRAM PALETTE (optional, defaults below)
     --s1 --s2 --s3  series colours      --muted-bar  de-emphasised bars      --hot  highlight colour (diagrams, chips)
     --rec-mix       tint of the recommended comparison column (13% light themes, about 24% on dark ones)
   ARABIC (optional)  --f-ar-d  display face for Arabic headings (Naskh for serif themes); default IBM Plex Sans Arabic
   TYPE SCALE (engine tokens, do not override per theme)  --t-display --t-h1 --t-h2 --t-h3 --t-body --t-small (28px floor)
   CODE (required)   --code-bg --code-ink --c-kw --c-str --c-num --c-com --c-fn   (each >= 4.5:1 on --code-bg)
   IMAGE OVERLAY (optional)    --scrim (gradient or colour under full-bleed titles)   --on-image (text on photos)
   CHROME           --letterbox   colour around the 16:9 stage
   ===================================================================== */
/* DEFAULTS: every optional token has a fallback here */
html{--rule-w:1px;--s1:var(--brand);--s2:var(--ink);--s3:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 38%,var(--bg));--muted-bar:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 32%,var(--bg));--hot:var(--brand);--rec-mix:13%;
  --scrim:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.72) 0,rgba(0,0,0,.35) 45%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 75%);--on-image:#fff;
  /* TYPE SCALE (px on the 1920 stage). --display-scale (set per font pairing) evens out faces with a small x-height. 28px is the floor for anything the audience reads. */
  --t-display:calc(164px*var(--display-scale,1));--t-h1:calc(132px*var(--display-scale,1));--t-h2:calc(84px*var(--display-scale,1));--t-h3:48px;--t-body:36px;--t-small:28px}

/* =====================================================================
   THEMES
   ===================================================================== */
/* THEME:keynote-white | Keynote White | #0066cc | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap */
html[data-theme="keynote-white"]{
  --bleed-bg:#0066cc; --bleed-ink:#ffffff;
  --bg:#ffffff; --bg2:#f5f5f7; --ink:#1d1d1f; --ink2:#5f5f64;
  --rule:#d2d2d7; --rule-strong:#1d1d1f; --brand:#0066cc; --brand-text:#0066cc; --on-brand:#ffffff;
  --hero-bg:#ffffff; --hero-ink:#1d1d1f; --hero-ink2:#5f5f64; --hero-rule:#d2d2d7; --hero-brand:#0066cc;
  --f-display:"Inter","SF Pro Display",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter","SF Pro Text",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  --w-display:700; --ls-display:-0.035em; --em-style:normal;
  --radius:14px; --chart-radius:6px; --letterbox:#0c0c0d;
  --code-bg:#f5f5f7; --code-ink:#1d1d1f; --c-kw:#9b2393; --c-str:#c41a16; --c-num:#1c00cf; --c-com:#5d6c79; --c-fn:#0f68a0;
}
/* /THEME */

/* THEME:keynote-black | Keynote Black | #2997ff | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap */
html[data-theme="keynote-black"]{
  --bleed-bg:#2997ff; --bleed-ink:#000000;
  --bg:#000000; --bg2:#161618; --ink:#f5f5f7; --ink2:#a1a1a6;
  --rule:#38383a; --rule-strong:#f5f5f7; --brand:#2997ff; --brand-text:#2997ff; --on-brand:#000000;
  --hero-bg:#000000; --hero-ink:#f5f5f7; --hero-ink2:#a1a1a6; --hero-rule:#38383a; --hero-brand:#2997ff;
  --f-display:"Inter","SF Pro Display",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter","SF Pro Text",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;
  --w-display:700; --ls-display:-0.035em; --em-style:normal;
  --em-fill:linear-gradient(90deg,#2997ff 0%,#c58bff 100%);
  --radius:14px; --chart-radius:6px; --letterbox:#000; --rec-mix:24%;
  --code-bg:#1c1c1e; --code-ink:#f5f5f7; --c-kw:#ff7ab2; --c-str:#ff8170; --c-num:#d9c97c; --c-com:#8e8e93; --c-fn:#6bdfff;
}
/* /THEME */

/* THEME:boardroom | Boardroom | #0b2545 | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,600;0,8..60,700;1,8..60,400;1,8..60,600&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap */
html[data-theme="boardroom"]{
  --bleed-bg:#c19a3d; --bleed-ink:#0b2545;
  --bg:#ffffff; --bg2:#eef1f6; --ink:#0b2545; --ink2:#46576f;
  --rule:#c8d0dc; --rule-strong:#0b2545; --brand:#c19a3d; --brand-text:#7a5a0a; --on-brand:#0b2545;
  --hero-bg:#0b2545; --hero-ink:#ffffff; --hero-ink2:#bcc8da; --hero-rule:#34507a; --hero-brand:#e2b658;
  --f-display:"Source Serif 4",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-body:"Source Sans 3","Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --w-display:600; --ls-display:-0.015em; --em-style:italic; --f-ar-d:"Noto Naskh Arabic","Amiri","Geeza Pro",serif; --w-display-ar:600;
  --radius:2px; --chart-radius:0px; --letterbox:#050e1c;
  --code-bg:#0b2545; --code-ink:#e8eef7; --c-kw:#e2b658; --c-str:#9fd3a8; --c-num:#f0a07a; --c-com:#9fb0c8; --c-fn:#8fc1ff;
}
[data-theme="boardroom"] .slide[data-layout="title"]::before,
[data-theme="boardroom"] .slide[data-layout="closing"]::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-block:0;inset-inline-start:0;width:28px;background:var(--brand)}
[data-theme="boardroom"] .kp-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:14px}
[data-theme="boardroom"] .chart .bar.s1{stroke:var(--rule-strong);stroke-width:1.5} /* the gold fill alone is 2.6:1 on white */
[data-theme="boardroom"] .slide:not([data-tone="hero"]):not([data-layout="title"]):not([data-layout="section"]):not([data-layout="closing"]):not([data-layout="full-bleed"]) > h2{border-inline-start:8px solid var(--brand);padding-inline-start:28px}
/* /THEME */

/* THEME:swiss | Swiss | #d7000f | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap */
html[data-theme="swiss"]{
  --bleed-bg:#d7000f; --bleed-ink:#ffffff;
  --bg:#ffffff; --bg2:#f0f0f0; --ink:#111111; --ink2:#555555;
  --rule:#cfcfcf; --rule-strong:#111111; --brand:#d7000f; --brand-text:#d7000f; --on-brand:#ffffff;
  --hero-bg:#d7000f; --hero-ink:#ffffff; --hero-ink2:#ffffff; --hero-rule:#ffffff; --hero-brand:#ffffff;
  --f-display:"Inter Tight","Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-body:"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --f-mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --w-display:700; --ls-display:-0.03em; --em-style:normal;
  --radius:0px; --chart-radius:0px; --letterbox:#1a1a1a;
  --code-bg:#111111; --code-ink:#f2f2f2; --c-kw:#ff7b7b; --c-str:#9ad1a0; --c-num:#f2c14e; --c-com:#9a9a9a; --c-fn:#8ab4ff;
}

[data-layout="big-number"] .big{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(400px*var(--fit));line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.05em;color:var(--brand-text);white-space:nowrap;padding-bottom:.04em}
[data-layout="big-number"] .big small{font-size:.36em;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-inline-start:.08em}
[data-layout="big-number"] p:not(.label):not(.src){margin-block-start:48px;padding-top:32px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);font-size:calc(46px*var(--fit));line-height:1.28;max-width:1200px;text-wrap:balance}
[data-layout="big-number"] .src{margin-block-start:20px}
/* stats */
[data-layout="stats"] .stat-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;margin-block:auto;padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat{align-self:start;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:32px;min-width:0}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);letter-spacing:-0.04em;line-height:1;font-size:calc(var(--sn,150px)*var(--fit));color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat b small{font-size:.5em;color:var(--brand-text);margin-inline-start:.06em;letter-spacing:0}
[data-layout="stats"] .stat span{display:block;margin-top:24px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink2);max-width:460px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="2"] .stat{grid-column:span 6}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="2"]{--sn:230px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="3"] .stat{grid-column:span 4}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="3"]{--sn:200px}
[data-layout="stats"][data-n="4"] .stat{grid-column:span 3}[data-layout="stats"][data-n="4"]{--sn:150px}
/* chart: text left (cols 1-4), plot right (cols 5-12); add data-wide for a full-width plot */
[data-layout="chart"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr;align-content:stretch}
[data-layout="chart"]>.label{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1}
[data-layout="chart"]>h2{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side{grid-column:1/5;grid-row:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px;padding-block-end:8px}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side>.src{margin-block-start:auto}
[data-layout="chart"]>.kp-side>.lede{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="chart"]>figure{grid-column:5/-1;grid-row:3;min-height:0}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:3;padding:0}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]{grid-template-rows:auto auto auto 1fr}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side:empty{display:none}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>figure{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4}
[data-layout="chart"][data-wide]>.kp-side>.lede{font-size:calc(var(--t-h3)*var(--fit));margin-block-end:8px}
/* comparison */
[data-layout="comparison"] h2{margin-block-end:44px}
table.cmp{margin-block:auto}
/* timeline */
[data-layout="timeline"] h2{margin-block-end:0}
.slide .timeline{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;margin-block:auto;position:relative}
.timeline li{flex:1;min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto 56px auto 1fr;padding-inline-end:40px;position:relative}
.timeline li::before{content:"";grid-row:2;align-self:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand);position:relative;z-index:1;box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--bg)}
.timeline li::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:calc(1.4em + 28px);inset-inline:0;height:2px;background:var(--rule-strong);margin-top:-1px}
.timeline li:last-child::after{inset-inline-end:auto;width:24px}
.timeline time{grid-row:1;font:500 var(--t-small)/1.4 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
.timeline h3{grid-row:3;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:calc(46px*var(--fit))}
.timeline p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
.timeline li.now::before{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--bg),0 0 0 11px var(--brand)}
/* process */
.slide .steps{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;gap:76px;margin-block:auto;counter-reset:st}
.steps li{flex:1;min-width:0;position:relative;counter-increment:st;border:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:44px 40px 52px;background:var(--bg)}
.steps li::before{content:counter(st);display:block;font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);margin-block-end:96px}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;inset-inline-start:calc(100% + 8px);width:60px;height:2px;background:var(--rule-strong);transform-origin:left center}
.steps li:not(:last-child)::before{}
.steps h3{margin-block-end:14px;font-size:calc(48px*var(--fit))}
.steps p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
[dir="rtl"] .steps li:not(:last-child)::after{transform:scaleX(-1)}
/* quote */
[data-layout="quote"]{justify-content:center;padding-inline:200px}
[data-layout="quote"] blockquote{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(96px*var(--fit));line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);text-wrap:balance;position:relative}
[data-layout="quote"] blockquote::before{content:"\201C";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-0.62em;top:-.02em;color:var(--brand-text);font-size:1.3em;line-height:1}
[dir="rtl"] [data-layout="quote"] blockquote::before{content:"\201D"}
[data-layout="quote"] cite{display:block;margin-block-start:56px;padding-top:28px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);max-width:620px;font:normal 500 30px/1.4 var(--f-body);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="quote"] cite b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
/* code */
[data-layout="code"] h2{margin-block-end:36px}
[data-layout="code"] .label{margin-block-end:20px}
/* team */
.slide .people{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--cols,4),1fr);gap:56px 40px;margin-block:auto}
[data-layout="team"] .person{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
[data-layout="team"] .person img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:var(--bg2)}
[data-layout="team"] .person:not(:has(img))::before{content:attr(data-initials);display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--brand-text);font:var(--w-display) 110px/1 var(--f-display);letter-spacing:var(--ls-display);border-bottom:6px solid var(--brand)}
[data-layout="team"] .person b{display:block;font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));font-weight:650;line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="team"] .person span{display:block;font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));color:var(--ink2);margin-top:6px}
/* references: numbered sources; cite them in slides with <sup class="cite">[1]</sup> */
[data-layout="references"] .refs{list-style:none;padding:0;counter-reset:ref;margin-block:auto;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);padding-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="references"] .refs li{counter-increment:ref;display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;column-gap:24px;padding:calc(22px*var(--fit)) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.35}
[data-layout="references"] .refs li::before{content:"[" counter(ref) "]";font:500 var(--t-small)/1.6 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="references"] .refs cite{font-style:normal;font-weight:600}
[data-layout="references"] .refs span{color:var(--ink2)}
.slide sup.cite{font:500 .5em/1 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text);vertical-align:.7em;margin-inline-start:.15em}
/* closing */
[data-layout="closing"]{justify-content:flex-end;padding-bottom:140px}
[data-layout="closing"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-display)*1.4*var(--fit));letter-spacing:-0.045em;line-height:.95;margin-block-end:56px}
[data-layout="closing"] .contact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 72px;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule);padding-top:32px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="closing"] .contact b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
[data-layout="closing"] .label{position:absolute;top:100px;inset-inline-start:120px;margin:0;white-space:nowrap}


/* diagram: h2 + one SVG figure (author the SVG at viewBox 1680 wide so 1 unit = 1px) */
[data-layout="diagram"] h2{margin-block-end:28px}
[data-layout="diagram"] figure.dg{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
[data-layout="diagram"] figure.dg svg{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible;font-family:var(--f-body)}
[data-layout="diagram"] figcaption{font:var(--t-small)/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2);margin-top:16px}
.dg-box{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink);stroke-width:3}.dg-fill{fill:var(--bg2);stroke:none}.dg-hot{fill:none;stroke:var(--hot);stroke-width:5}
.dg-line{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.dg-line.hot{stroke:var(--hot);stroke-width:5}
.dg-t{fill:var(--ink);font-size:36px;font-weight:600}.dg-s{fill:var(--ink2);font-size:28px}.dg-m{fill:var(--ink2);font:500 28px var(--f-mono)}.dg-b{fill:var(--brand-text);font-size:36px;font-weight:650}
.dg-dot{fill:var(--ink)}.dg-dot.hot{fill:var(--hot)}
/* ---- library layouts: case, ask, rows, quiz, materials, formula; two-column data-cols="3" ---- */
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col{grid-column:span 4;padding-inline-end:40px}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col:last-of-type{padding-inline-end:0}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] .col h3{font-size:calc(48px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="two-column"][data-cols="3"] :is(.col p,.col ul){font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)))}
/* case: summary left, vitals + course right (clinical case, incident, customer story) */
[data-layout="case"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto auto 1fr;align-content:stretch}
[data-layout="case"]>:is(h2,.label){grid-column:1/-1}
[data-layout="case"]>.label{grid-row:1}[data-layout="case"]>h2{grid-row:2}
[data-layout="case"] .pt{grid-column:1/6;grid-row:4/6;border-top:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:28px;padding-inline-end:24px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt h3{font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);margin-block-end:10px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt p{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));line-height:1.36;margin-block-end:30px}
[data-layout="case"] .pt p:last-child{margin-block-end:0}
[data-layout="case"] .vitals{grid-column:6/-1;grid-row:4;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:0 28px;margin-block-end:48px}
[data-layout="case"] .vital{border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:20px;min-width:0}
[data-layout="case"] .vital span{display:block;font:500 max(28px,calc(26px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="case"] .vital b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(84px*var(--fit));line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-0.03em;white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="case"] .vital small{font-size:max(28px,calc(28px*var(--fit)));letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink2);margin-inline-start:.2em}
[data-layout="case"] .vital[data-flag] b{color:var(--hot-text,var(--brand-text))}
[data-layout="case"] .vital[data-flag]::after{content:attr(data-flag);display:block;margin-top:6px;font:500 var(--t-small) var(--f-mono);color:var(--hot-text,var(--brand-text))}
[data-layout="case"] .course{grid-column:6/-1;grid-row:5;list-style:none;padding:0;margin-inline-start:7px;border-inline-start:2px solid var(--rule-strong);align-self:start}
[data-layout="case"] .course li{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;gap:0 20px;padding:calc(16px*var(--fit)) 0 calc(16px*var(--fit)) 36px;font-size:calc(36px*var(--fit));line-height:1.3}
[data-layout="case"] .course li::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-9px;top:calc(16px*var(--fit) + .4em);width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand)}
[data-layout="case"] .course time{font:500 max(28px,calc(26px*var(--fit)))/1.5 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
/* ask: the raise (amount, use of funds, terms); also budget asks and grant requests */
[data-layout="ask"]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);column-gap:40px;grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto;align-content:start}
[data-layout="ask"]>:is(h2,.label){grid-column:1/-1}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount{grid-column:1/7;grid-row:3;align-self:center}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount b{display:block;font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:var(--w-display);font-size:calc(300px*var(--fit));line-height:1;letter-spacing:-0.05em;color:var(--brand-text);white-space:nowrap}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount b small{font-size:.5em;letter-spacing:-0.02em;margin-inline-start:.04em}
[data-layout="ask"] .amount span{display:block;margin-top:20px;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink2);max-width:700px}
[data-layout="ask"] .use{grid-column:8/-1;grid-row:3;align-self:center;list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(34px*var(--fit))}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px 20px;align-items:baseline;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li span{font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;font-size:.8em}
[data-layout="ask"] .use li i{grid-column:1/-1;display:block;height:18px;width:calc(var(--w,50)*1%);background:var(--brand);border-radius:var(--radius)}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:4;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:40px;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong);padding-top:24px;margin-block-start:48px}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms dt{font:500 max(28px,calc(24px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="ask"] .terms dd{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:calc(38px*var(--fit));font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
/* rows: labelled rows (issue / rule / application / conclusion; situation / complication / resolution; claim / evidence) */
[data-layout="rows"] h2{margin-block-end:36px}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:2px solid var(--rule-strong)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr;column-gap:40px;padding:calc(24px*var(--fit)) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li::before{content:attr(data-k);grid-row:1/span 2;font:500 max(28px,calc(28px*var(--fit)))/1.5 var(--f-mono);color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li>*{grid-column:2}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows h3{font-size:calc(40px*var(--fit));margin-block-end:6px}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows p{font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.38;color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li[data-hot]{background:var(--bg2);box-shadow:-28px 0 0 var(--bg2),28px 0 0 var(--bg2);border-bottom-color:var(--brand)}
[data-layout="rows"] .rows>li[data-hot] p{color:var(--ink)}
/* quiz: a question and 2 to 4 options; data-build="reveal" on the list marks the right answer on click */
[data-layout="quiz"]{justify-content:center}
[data-layout="quiz"] h2{font-size:calc(var(--t-h2)*var(--fit));margin-block-end:64px;max-width:1560px}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:36px 40px;counter-reset:q}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li{counter-increment:q;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;border:max(var(--rule-w,1px),2px) solid var(--rule-strong);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:calc(40px*var(--fit)) 40px;font-size:calc(50px*var(--fit));line-height:1.22;transition:background-color .4s,color .4s,border-color .4s}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li::before{content:counter(q,upper-alpha);flex:none;width:84px;height:84px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);color:var(--ink);font:700 42px/1 var(--f-display)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li[data-correct]{background:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .opts li[data-correct]::before{background:var(--on-brand);color:var(--brand-text)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="reveal"]:not(.is-on) li[data-correct]{background:transparent;border-color:var(--rule-strong);color:var(--ink)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="reveal"]:not(.is-on) li[data-correct]::before{background:var(--bg2);color:var(--ink)}
[data-layout="quiz"] .lede{margin-block-start:36px;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)))}
/* materials: a board of swatches, textures or photos with captions */
[data-layout="materials"] h2{margin-block-end:40px}
[data-layout="materials"] .board{flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;gap:36px;counter-reset:mat}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;min-width:0;counter-increment:mat}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat::before{content:"";flex:1;min-height:160px;background:var(--tx,linear-gradient(transparent,transparent)),var(--sw,var(--bg2));border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 16%,transparent)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat:has(img)::before{display:none}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat img{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:var(--radius)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption b{display:block;font-size:max(28px,calc(32px*var(--fit)));font-weight:650;line-height:1.2}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font:max(28px,calc(24px*var(--fit)))/1.3 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="materials"] .mat figcaption span::before{content:"M-0" counter(mat) "  "}
/* formula: one big equation and its terms */
[data-layout="formula"] h2{margin-block-end:24px}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq{font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:400;font-size:calc(140px*var(--fit));line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-0.01em;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;padding:36px 0;margin-block:auto 44px;border-block:var(--rule-w,1px) solid var(--rule-strong)}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq i{font-style:italic}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq sub{font-size:max(28px,.5em);line-height:0;font-style:normal}
[data-layout="formula"] .eq .hot{color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms:not(:has(~ .example)){margin-block-end:auto}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px 72px}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:0 20px;align-items:baseline;font-size:max(28px,calc(34px*var(--fit)));line-height:1.3}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt{font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.15em;color:var(--brand-text)}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt i{font-style:italic}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dt sub{font-size:max(28px,.6em);line-height:0}
[data-layout="formula"] .terms dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink2)}
[data-layout="formula"] .example{margin-block-end:auto;margin-block-start:36px;font:calc(32px*var(--fit))/1.4 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
/* chip: a boxed inline token */
.chip{display:inline-block;border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:.12em .5em;font-family:var(--f-mono);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.25}
.chip.hot{background:var(--hot);border-color:var(--hot);color:var(--on-brand)}
.chip-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;font-size:56px}

/* footer (not on title / section / full-bleed / closing) */
.kp-foot{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;bottom:36px;inset-inline:120px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 20px/1.2 var(--f-mono);color:var(--ink2)}
.slide:is([data-layout="title"],[data-layout="section"],[data-layout="full-bleed"],[data-layout="closing"],[data-footer="off"]) .kp-foot{display:none}

/* ---------- 4. Builds ---------- (hidden states exist only on live slides, never in thumbnails or print) */
.kp-live .kb{transition:opacity .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="fade"],.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="count"]{opacity:0}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="rise"]{opacity:0;transform:translateY(44px)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="scale"]{opacity:0;transform:scale(.88)}
.kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="wipe"]{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}
[dir="rtl"] .kp-live .kb:not(.is-on)[data-kb="wipe"]{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 100%)}
.kp-live .kb[data-kb="wipe"].is-on{clip-path:inset(-20px -20px -20px -20px)}
.kd{stroke-dasharray:1 2;stroke-dashoffset:0}

# Engine notes (read when the deck needs one of these)

Contents: slide links · live demos on slides · narration · `window.kp` API · slide attributes · old decks

## Slide links

Every slide has its own address: `my-deck.html#pricing`. It comes from `data-id="pricing"` on the `<section>`, otherwise from
the slide title, otherwise `#slide-7` (`#/7` and `#7` also work). Set `data-id` on slides people will link to (the ask, the
pricing, the demo) and keep ids short, lowercase, unique and stable across edits, because links already shared depend on them.
**K** copies the current slide's link; the outline (**O**) has a `#` per slide and "Links" copies them all.

## Slides that run: live demos on a slide

When a live demo beats a picture (product UI, calculator, simulation, sound, code to edit, a game, an embedded page, video,
camera), build it on the slide. `assets/examples/beyond-slides.html` has one working pattern for each; copy from it.
What those patterns get right, and why:
- Slide: `data-layout="two-column" data-fit="off" data-demo`, a `.col.bx-text` (label, h2, short text) and a `.col.bx-stage.bx-ui`.
- Wrap widgets in `.bx-ui` and stop `click` there, or every click inside the demo advances the deck. Text inputs stop
  `keydown` and blur on Enter/Escape, so typing does not trigger deck shortcuts.
- Colours come from theme tokens (`getComputedStyle(slide).getPropertyValue('--brand')` for canvas), re-read on slide enter,
  so pressing **S** restyles demos too.
- Animate, play sound, video or camera only while the slide has `.is-current` (watch its class with a MutationObserver) and stop
  on leave; otherwise a hidden slide burns CPU or keeps talking. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Load iframes on enter
  (`data-src`). Camera and sound start from a button, never on their own.
- Text in widgets stays at 28px or more (the checker's floor). Wait for `window.kp.ready` before wiring.

## Narration

`<main class="deck" data-narration="audio/my-deck/">` plays `<folder>/<slide link id>.mp3` per slide (key **A** or the speaker
button, which stays hidden until the first slide's clip exists, so a deck can ship before its audio). While on, each slide
plays its clip, reveals its builds and advances when the clip ends; a slide without a clip shows a note and moves on after 3 s.
Write one transcript per slide and name clips by `data-id`.

## `window.kp` (after `kp.ready`)

`go(i, step)`, `next()`, `prev()`, `showAll(i)`, `refit()`, `outline()`, `count`, `state`, `slugs`, `link(i)`, `copyLink(i)`,
`applyLook(theme, fonts, persist, preview)` (fonts `''` = the theme's own), `themes`, `fonts` (id lists). The registry is read
from the marker comments in `<style id="kp-themes">`.

## Slide attributes and small facts

- Layouts (`data-layout`): agenda, appendix, ask, big-number, bullets, case, chart, closing, code, comparison, diagram, formula,
  full-bleed, image-left, image-right, materials, process, quiz, quote, references, rows, section, statement, stats, team,
  timeline, title, two-column. Unknown layouts are a checker error.
- `data-id` (link), `data-footer="off"`, `data-fit="off"`, `data-skip`, `data-tone="hero"`, `data-transition="push|move-in|none"`.
- An appendix slide (`data-layout="appendix"` or `data-appendix`) and everything after it are skipped in play: backup slides.
- `data-duration="20"` on `<main class="deck">` turns the presenter timer into a 20-minute countdown.
- Keys are ignored while focus is in an input, textarea, select or editable text, so interactive slides can take typing.
- An inline element at the very top of a slide trips the safe-area warning: put a label in `.label`, not a loose `<em>`.

## Old decks

`node "<skill base dir>/scripts/upgrade.mjs" deck.html` moves a deck made with an older engine onto the current one, keeping its slides and looks.
